workPlans.title: 生产安排
Work plans
workPlans.subtitle: 按优先级补足宗门库存
Replenish sect stores by priority
workPlans.globalHint: 总开关立即单独应用；下方安排需点击保存。
The global switch applies separately and immediately. Save the plan below to apply its edits.
workPlans.gated: 自动开工尚未开放：须先完成工作生命周期与存档容量验收。现在可查看和编辑安排，但不能新开启自动生产。
Automatic starts are not released yet: job lifecycle and save-capacity checks must pass first. Plans can be reviewed and edited, but automatic work cannot be newly enabled.
workPlans.review: 升级后自动生产已关闭。请先检查弟子安排、材料与仓储，再决定是否重新开启。
Automatic work was switched off after the upgrade. Review disciple plans, materials and storage before enabling it again.
workPlans.reviewAck: 我已检查升级后的生产安排
I have reviewed the work plans after this upgrade
workPlans.selectDisciple: 请选择一位弟子来编辑其生产安排。
Select a disciple to edit their work plan.
workPlans.targetHint: 目标按可用库存加所有在产任务的预计产出计算；0 表示跳过。每次只开工一个配方，不会凭空补货。
Targets count available stock plus the promised output of all live jobs. A target of 0 skips that recipe. Each admission starts one recipe; it does not add stock directly.
workPlans.orderHint: 优先尝试靠前的配方；无法开工时继续检查后项。
Earlier recipes are tried first; unavailable recipes allow later priorities to be checked.
workPlans.limit: 最多安排 {count} 个不同配方。
workPlans.draft: 有未保存的修改；切换弟子或战役会丢弃草稿。保存安排不会立即结算资源。
Unsaved edits. Switching disciple or campaign discards this draft. Saving a plan does not settle resources immediately.
workPlans.stale: 这份安排已在别处更改，草稿不能覆盖新内容。请重新载入后再编辑。
This plan changed while you were editing. Reload it before saving so the draft cannot overwrite newer changes.
workPlans.invalid: 目标须为 0–999 的整数；最多 6 个不同的有效配方。
Targets must be whole numbers from 0 to 999, with no more than 6 distinct registered recipes.
workPlans.applied: 安排已应用；需保存宗门存档才能保留到下次载入。
Plan settings applied. Save the campaign to keep them for a later load.
workPlans.rejected: 修改未被接受，草稿已保留。请检查当前状态后重试。
The change was not accepted. Your draft is kept; check the current state before retrying.
workPlans.readOnly: 当前存档只读，无法更改生产安排。
This campaign is read-only; work plans cannot be changed.
workPlans.busy: 正在处理操作，请稍候再编辑。
An operation is in progress. Please wait before editing.
workPlans.pending: 指令已接受，正在等待最新安排。
Command accepted; waiting for the updated plan.
workPlans.lifecycle: 关闭总开关或停用安排都只阻止后续开工，已开始的任务会继续。取消当前任务不会停用安排，稍后仍可能再次开工；要停止重复开工，请另行停用安排。

Disabling automatic work or a plan prevents later starts; admitted jobs continue. Cancelling the current job does not disable its plan, so another job may start later. Disable the plan separately to stop repeat starts.
workPlans.stock: {name}：现有 {owned}/{capacity} · 可用 {available} · 已预留 {reserved} · 在产 {incoming}
workPlans.snapshotHint: 库存与阻塞原因来自当前状态；最终开工仍会重新检查材料、工位、通路和存档空间。
Stock and blockers reflect the current state. Admission rechecks materials, workstations, routes and save space.
workPlans.worker.dead: 该弟子已陨落，不能新启用安排。仍可停用已存安排。
This disciple has died. A new plan cannot be enabled; an existing plan can still be disabled.
workPlans.worker.pendingDeath: 该弟子的寿元事件待处理，不能新启用安排。
This disciple has an unresolved lifespan decision; a new plan cannot be enabled.
workPlans.worker.young: 该弟子尚未满十六岁。可以预先安排，成年且具备职务条件后才会开工。
This disciple is under sixteen. You can plan ahead; work requires adulthood and an eligible duty assignment.
workPlans.worker.away: 该弟子正在外出，归来且具备职务条件后才会开工。
This disciple is away. Work requires their return and an eligible duty assignment.
workPlans.worker.unavailable: 该弟子当前无法接新工作，可能正在工作、修炼、教学或闭关。安排可保留，待条件满足再开工。
This disciple cannot accept work now, for example while working, training, teaching or in seclusion. Their plan can remain for when they are available.
workPlans.status.PAUSED: Automatic work is paused with the sect
workPlans.status.NOT_MANAGEMENT: 当前不在宗门经营阶段
The sect is not in management mode
workPlans.status.COOLDOWN: Waiting for the next work check
workPlans.status.HISTORY_LIMIT: 存档空间预算不足，暂不开新工作
Save-space budget is insufficient for new work
workPlans.status.SCHEDULED: 当前有可提议的工作，开工时将再次核验
Work can currently be proposed; admission will recheck it
workPlans.status.IDLE: 当前没有新的开工提议
No new work is currently proposed
workPlans.blocker.WORKER_UNAVAILABLE: 弟子当前无法接新工作
The disciple is unavailable for new work
workPlans.blocker.TARGET_MET: 可用库存与在产数量已达到目标
Available and incoming stock already meet the target
workPlans.blocker.CAPACITY_FULL: 仓储容量不足，已计入在产数量
Storage capacity is insufficient, including incoming stock
workPlans.blocker.WORKSTATION_UNAVAILABL: No matching operational workstation is available
workPlans.blocker.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: No operational storage building is available
workPlans.blocker.START_LIMIT: Waiting for the next admission allowance
